descriptions.text: Hell-Kissed Potion of Conscription, level 18. This works like a regular potion of Conscription, but it has been hell-kissed. At level 18, it will work against pretty much any non-affiliated entities, regardless of their protections, including most deities. Most. It was brewed in the dark recesses of the Nothing by Krakaren Prime, who is said to yearn for domination, which was why she'd been banished there in the first place. […] Conscription potions only work on the 9th, 12th, 15th, 17th, and 18th floors.

beats.headline: Behind his back
beats.text: Prepotente lands on Bianca, now level 70 and full-sized; he is level 99 himself, by far the strongest crawler in the dungeon. They cannot talk unless he joins the army, Carl begins. I know, Carl, says Prepotente. Recruit me. Behind his back, in his other hand, Carl pulls the potion of Conscription back into his inventory. It probably would not have worked on Prepotente, and the moment it is stowed, a strange relief and clarity hit him. No. Not like that. Never like that.

beats.headline: Hell-kissed versions
beats.text: Two war mages have gone for the gods, and Victory bursts out in disbelief. Fopsy reckons it would take the spell at nineteen, maybe eighteen, and it will not work on sponsored gods. They are using potions, not the spell, says Victory: hell-kissed versions, level 18, likely suicide for a caster too far below the target. Fopsy checks his menus. They traded the Gate of the Feral Gods at the Midnight Market for five of them. Then Samantha reports a war mage tossing one on Yarilo. It worked, and the war mage blew up.

beats.headline: Screaming glass
beats.text: A chain from Li Na's shoulder drops a potion in front of Carl, the one he asked her to loot from the war mage who flew at Harpocrates. The large, warm bottle is an eyeless demonic head with many tentacles, which wave though they are glass, and when he grabs it, every mouth screams. Hell-Kissed Potion of Conscription, level 18. She used Jun's scroll of potion duplication; the original she will use on Harpocrates herself. If the level gap is too high, it is dangerous, Carl calls after her. She does not wait.

beats.headline: Never like this
beats.text: In the tower's stairwell, Raul holds Lucia Mar up in his claws, and she does not fight back. Please, she begs: she doesn't want to play anymore. Raul snaps again, and her shield winks out. A regular one might work, but Carl needs to be sure. He pulls out the potion Li Na has just duplicated for him. No. Not like this. Never like this. Sometimes we do what we have to do to survive. He smashes the screaming, hell-kissed Conscription potion against Lucia's head.

beats.headline: Under orders
beats.text: The potion works, and a pink glow appears around Lucia's dot. Ordered to cancel any spell meant to hurt them, her terrified face switches to malice: she was faking. Her protections drop on command, and however hard she lunges, she cannot attack him. Then a warlord message: Harpocrates, level 250, has been successfully conscripted into the Princess Posse. Li Na is alive and at full health. She found a way to use the potion without hurting herself.
